main_text.head: De Lectionis Exercitatio- ne & Confirmatione.
main_text.p: COgnitis literis & vocalibus, obseruatis etiam generalibus ad legendum regulis, ipsa Lectio statim tentanda erit.
Lectio instituatur quotidiana, per horam minimum, nec dies vllus sine exercitio abeat.

Primum Lectionis tentamen sit in formis Conjugationum, quæ ordine juxta septem verborum classes perlegendæ; Ratio, 1. quia ibi legendi modus est facilior, quum eædem literæ & voces repetantur, unâ duntaxat aut altera syllabâ immutatâ. 2. quia facilitatem hanc statim sequitur aliquis profectus. 3. quia profectus iste amorem studii generat, & continuationem

page.notes: Initial "C" is a large decorative capital (COgnitis). The catchword "nem" is printed at lower right and is the start of "nem[...]" continuing the sentence; the last word is partly underlined in print. The header ornament is decorative and not transcribed. Line "vllus" is printed with a long-s ligature style; read as vllus.
